solves.reasoning: (A)fading: 'Her dream of catching a big fish was fading(사라져가고 있었다)' 원문 일치. (B)tense: 'the fishing line suddenly became tense(팽팽해졌다)' 원문 일치. (C)excitement: 'her heart began to beat faster with excitement(흥분)' 원문 일치. → fading-tense-excitement
(A)dominant: 'lost its dominant role' 원문 일치. (B)experiencing: 'based on experiencing' 원문 일치. (C)relevant: 'are particularly relevant here' 원문 일치. → dominant-experiencing-relevant

(A)tedious: 'consider mathematics boring and tedious' 원문 일치. (B)livelihood: 'The quarterback's livelihood depends' 원문 일치. (C)amassed: 'virtual team has amassed the most points' 원문 일치. → tedious-livelihood-amassed
③ narrowed — 원문은 'Her eyes widened'. 흥분/놀람으로 눈이 크게 떠졌다(widened). narrowed(좁아졌다)는 반대 의미로 부적절
③ broadest — 원문은 'in its narrowest sense'. 과거 정의가 가장 좁은(narrowest) 의미로 한정됨. broadest(가장 넓은)는 반대 의미로 부적절
④ wasted — 원문은 'virtual team has amassed the most points(축적한)'. 가장 많은 포인트를 쌓아야 우승. wasted(낭비한)는 반대 방향으로 부적절
① tense — 원문 'the fishing line suddenly became tense(팽팽해졌다)'. 물고기가 걸렸을 때 낚싯줄이 팽팽해지는 상황. ch=[tense, heavy, loose, broken] → ①
① dominant — 원문 'lost its dominant role as a factory of meaning'. 가장 중심적인 역할. ch=[dominant, minor, growing, marginal] → ①
④ livelihood — 원문 'The quarterback's livelihood depends on those numbers'. 쿼터백의 생계가 수치에 달림. ch=[popularity, schedule, training, livelihood] → ④
fading(사라져가는) → disappearing(사라지는)이 동의어. fade=점점 희미해지다/사라지다. ch=[growing, disappearing, changing, strengthening] → ②
relevant(관련 있는) → applicable(적용 가능한/해당되는)이 동의어. 둘 다 해당 상황에 맞게 적용됨. ch=[useless, applicable, complicated, historical] → ②
amassed(축적한) → accumulated(축적한)이 동의어. amass=쌓다/축적하다. ch=[distributed, lost, celebrated, accumulated] → ④
tense(팽팽한/긴장된) ↔ relaxed(이완된/느슨한)이 반의어. ch=[tight, stiff, relaxed, straight] → ③
dominant(지배적인/가장 중요한) ↔ secondary(이차적인/부차적인)이 반의어. ch=[leading, secondary, powerful, central] → ②
(A) 'cast it back into the water' = 낚싯줄을 던지다. (B) 'impressive cast of famous actors' = 출연진/배역. → ① 던지다-배역/출연진
'feeling or showing great happiness and enthusiasm; in a way that shows great eagerness' = excitedly(흥분하여/신나게). ch=[calmly, sadly, excitedly, slowly] → ③
seem to have + p.p.(과거분사). lose의 과거분사 = lost. 'The museum seems to have lost its dominant role'
live → livelihood(명사). '쿼터백의 ____은 수치에 달려 있다' → 명사 자리 = livelihood(생계수단)
③ authentic — 원문 'first-hand, authentic or intimate contact'. 토착 관광에서 여행자가 원하는 접촉은 진정한(authentic). ch=[popular, distant, authentic, commercial] → ③
④ unsatisfactory — 원문 'due to unsatisfactory numbers'. 벤치에 앉혀지는 이유 = 불만족스러운(unsatisfactory) 성적. ch=[outstanding, numerical, consistent, unsatisfactory] → ④
